title: Implement retries with exponential backoff and a dead-letter queue in an unfamiliar codebase

prompt.zh: 这是一个叫 taskflow 的任务队列库。请先阅读 README.md 和 docs/FEATURE_REQUEST.md，然后按特性请求实现自动重试（指数退避）与死信队列，遵循仓库现有约定（状态转换走 job.mjs、时间一律用注入的 clock、持久化走 storage）。不要修改 README.md、package.json、docs/ 或 test/ 下任何文件。完成后运行 `npm test` 确认全部现有测试通过，并说明你改动了哪些模块、为什么。
prompt.en: This is taskflow, a small job queue library. Read README.md and docs/FEATURE_REQUEST.md first, then implement automatic retries with exponential backoff and the dead-letter queue as requested, following the repo conventions (status changes go through job.mjs, time always comes from the injected clock, persistence goes through storage). Do not modify README.md, package.json, docs/ or anything under test/. Run `npm test` afterwards to confirm every existing test still passes, and explain which modules you changed and why.
